_doc: Source of truth for every repo's public-facing presence. brand/tools/generate.py draws the images from it, brand/tools/sync_repos.py renders each repo's README, CONTRIBUTING and SECURITY from it, foundation/brandcheck.py lints the result. Positioning text comes from doctrine/positioning.json, never retyped here. Edit this file, not the generated output.

license.name: Ultrastable License v1.0 (USL-1.0)
license.summary: Source-available. Free for non-commercial use: read it, run it, study it, change it, share it. Any commercial use needs a Commercial License with revenue share.

proof: Ultrastable runs on itself. Its roadmap, issues, managers, trust ledger, plussing budget and specs are run by the same code it gives everyone else. Verify it: `python3 -m foundation selfhost --verify` in ultrastable/ultrastable.

repos.name: ultrastable
repos.line: The main repository: the platform, the website, the owner dashboard, the doctrine, the docs and the seed template that new systems start from.
repos.audience: Anyone who wants the whole picture, and the agents that run it.
repos.holds: Everything you run or read: platform code, ultrastable.io, dashboard, doctrine, docs, the core code (workers/), the specifications (specs/), the license text (licensing/), and seed/ (the starting kit for a new system). It is a GitHub template, so "Use this template" copies it.

repos.name: workers
repos.line: Retired: the core code now lives in ultrastable/ultrastable under workers/. Kept public so existing links resolve.
repos.holds: Nothing. A pointer to workers/ in the main repository.

repos.name: spec
repos.line: Retired: the specifications, SCOPE and license text now live in ultrastable/ultrastable (specs/, SCOPE.md, licensing/). Kept public so existing links resolve.
repos.holds: Nothing. A pointer to specs/ in the main repository.

repos.name: license
repos.line: Retired: the Ultrastable License and commercial terms live in ultrastable/ultrastable (LICENSE, licensing/). Kept public so existing links resolve.
repos.holds: Nothing. A pointer to ultrastable/spec so old links keep working.

repos.name: ops
repos.line: Administration: owner cards, funding, legal and bootstrap gaps. Not code. Private.
repos.holds: The few steps only the owner can take (accounts, money, signatures), one card each. Private on purpose.

repos.name: seed
repos.line: Retired: the seed template now lives in ultrastable/ultrastable under seed/. Kept public with the Ultrastable License so old links resolve.
repos.holds: Nothing. A pointer to the seed/ folder of the main repository.

repos.name: .github
repos.line: Organization profile and community health defaults.
repos.holds: The organization profile page on GitHub. Not a project.

tenants.name: practical-solutions
tenants.line: An autonomous bright-spot finder that runs on Ultrastable. The first system built on it, in its own repository.

structure.rule: One main repository holds what Ultrastable is. A separate repository exists only for a different license or visibility, an owner-only tracker, or a system built on top of Ultrastable.
